formal_object: Observed local relative rotations R_ij in SO(3), anchor graph weights w_ij>=0; unknown patch rotations R_i.

operations.input: R_i -> R_i Q for common Q

operations.condition: Relative-rotation directions and weights are explicit

operations.input: Relax SO(3) blocks to a global orthogonality constraint
operations.condition: Relaxation and block projection are tracked separately
operations.output: Spectral candidate followed by SO(3) projection

derivation_steps.statement: The relative objective is invariant to a common right rotation Q.
derivation_steps.justification: Frobenius norms are invariant under right orthogonal multiplication.

derivation_steps.statement: Stack blocks U_i=R_i and write the objective as tr(U^T L U).
derivation_steps.justification: Expand weighted graph edge squares into the symmetric connection Laplacian.

derivation_steps.statement: Under U^T U=nI, the bottom three eigenvectors minimize the relaxed objective; project each block to SO(3).
derivation_steps.justification: Rayleigh-Ritz solves the relaxation. Projection can increase its objective.

assumptions: The observation graph must connect each synchronized component.
No global optimum or exact recovery is claimed after projecting spectral blocks.
Relative rotations inferred from wrong correspondences can still synchronize coherently to a wrong motion.
An anchored gauge and common reconstruction backend are required.
method_expression: Synchronize model-derived patch rotations, fix one gauge and reconstruct with a qualified common lift.
distinguishing_prediction: Loop-inconsistent local rotations should improve more than already consistent graphs; independent local fitting should suffice in the latter case.
falsifier: Reject as a new method if ordinary rotation synchronization already covers the whole claim or if matched local-rigid fitting resolves the native residual.
closest_alternative: Classical group synchronization and STAC geodesic local rigid fitting.
decisive_comparison: Independent local fits versus graph synchronization with the same matches and geometry lift; native scoring and matched eigensolver overhead.
operational_delta: Global relative-rotation consistency is distinct from C10's integrability, but prior-art coverage is strong; reserve.
feasibility_and_cost: Sparse block eigensolve and projection; reliable pairwise rotations and native residual necessity remain missing.
structural_signature: SO(3) graph-gauge synchronization, not coordinate smoothing.
algebra_review_basis: Checked gauge invariance, quadratic expansion and the relaxation/projection gap.
empirical_status: Not implemented in this round; no native method comparison or outcome.
originality_status: Unadjudicated. Classical tools and historical related code are explicitly attributed.
